newsitem.title: USA: Arco to acquire 52 retail outlets in B.C.
newsitem.headline: Arco to acquire 52 retail outlets in B.C.

text.p: ARCO Products Co announced Thursday it will expand into British Columbia, Canada, with the acquisition of 52 Super-Save Gas stores in the Vancouver area.
ARCO Products, the refining and marketing division of Los Angeles-based Atlantic Richfield Co., has signed a letter of intent to acquire the stores from the Actton Group of Companies.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

"We see the greater Vancouver area as one of the fast-growing communities in North America and believe it fits well with our long- term marketing plans and offers tremendous potential," said Steve Rullo, senior vice president for ARCO Products Co.
ARCO operates more than 1,700 retail outlets and 14 distribution terminals in Washington, Oregon, California, Arizona and Nevada.
ARCO will supply the Vancouver area retail outlets from its Cherry Point Refinery in Ferndale, Wash., the company said.
The refinery processes more than 210,000 barrels of Alaskan North Slope crude oil daily and supplies all of ARCO's retail gasoline outlets in the Pacific Northwest.
ARCO plans to open a distribution terminal in British Columbia (B.C.) but will supply its Super-Save retail outlets with from Cherry Point until a new terminal is built in B.C.
